brief: Today's posts were mostly light: Codex capacity errors, a Codex-related fix, and Claude design workflows from Anthropic's Nate Parrott. The most notable item beyond that is Guillermo Rauch's launch of xeet, a Rust/wasm X post renderer that renders to PNG in about 1ms.

themes.label: Claude design workflows
themes.summary: Peter Yang's interview with Anthropic's Nate Parrott covers how prototyping is faster now and how to stop Claude defaulting to the same visual style.

themes.label: Codex capacity errors
themes.summary: Thibault Sottiaux said the Codex team may have fixed the "model at capacity" errors, and Nan Yu asked how to use Codex to control home automation.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary: Said the Codex team might have fixed the "model at capacity" errors that have been affecting users.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Introduced xeet, a hermetic X post renderer in safe Rust and wasm that renders a post to PNG in about 1ms without a browser. He also shared a playful CLI naming story.

builders.name: No Priors
builders.summary: Posted an episode with Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev covering tokenization, agentic trading, and expanding ownership, including a claim that over 150,000 customers have opened agentic trading accounts.

builders.name: Nan Yu
builders.summary: Asked for a plug-and-play home automation hub that Codex could control, and joked about a Waymo's windshield wipers. Mostly personal posts.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Shared quotes from Anthropic's Nate Parrott on compressed build cycles and on prompting Claude to avoid default visual styles. Also questioned a NYTimes story on Alice Huang.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Announced a weekly guest series with Kanav Gupta, cofounder of Core Auto, on RL methods and synthetic data, held in person in SF.

builders.name: Thariq
builders.summary: Shared a brief post announcing a new arena and two new characters, with no further detail.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary: Posted that it had been an interesting 48 hours and shared a short note calling a linked post a good summary.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary: Described building a compounding skill for context window summaries, iterated with autoresearch until it matched 80% of his taste versus a no-skill baseline.

builders.name: Zara Zhang
builders.summary: Posted a short observation that being good at LinkedIn probably makes you bad at X, plus a personal remark about a store.

builders.name: Aditya Agarwal
builders.summary: Shared a note from an Indian aerospace company about a early-morning first flight on a remote runway, with the line "Ad Astra."

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Posted several short, minor notes about a talk recap written by clanker. Nothing substantive.
